text:
jia: Putting up mosaic-14b-q8 sweep results for H100/us-west and L4/ap-southeast. TL;DR: batch_window and kernel choices matter for APAC fairness.

Tom: Drop numbers?

jia: Quick summary (approx):
H100/us-west -> p95 42ms, p99 120ms, throughput ~1200 tps.
L4/ap-southeast -> p95 140ms, p99 420ms, throughput ~420 tps.

sam: What were the batch/scheduler settings?

jia: Defaults: batch_window_ms=8, max_batch_tokens=2048, scheduler=continuous. When I increased batch_window_ms to 20 and max_batch_tokens to 4096 on L4, p99 dropped to ~310ms and throughput +12%.

leah: :thinking:

jia: Also compared kernels: attn-tilt-v2 vs attn-basic. attn-tilt-v2 reduced H100 p95 by ~6ms but caused p99 regressions for small requests (1-20 tokens).

infra-bot: run-id: bench/195555-01
cmd: ./bench --model mosaic-14b-q8 --gpu H100 --region us-west --batch-window-ms 8 --max-batch-tokens 2048

jia: Perf excerpt:
```
model mosaic-14b-q8 | gpu H100 | bw 8ms  | max 2048 | p95 42ms  p99 120ms  tps 1200
model mosaic-14b-q8 | gpu L4   | bw 8ms  | max 2048 | p95 140ms p99 420ms  tps 420
model mosaic-14b-q8 | gpu L4   | bw 20ms | max 4096 | p95 120ms p99 310ms  tps 470
```

sam: Any quality regressions from q8 quant?

jia: Minor: small uptick in repetition for >512 token outputs, but overall eval metrics remain within our alert thresholds. We'll run the eval harness on eval-set-2026-03 just to be safe.

Tom: For fairness, were tenant cohorts getting starved? Any long tails per-tenant?

jia: Yes — observed tilt where small-token cohorts (~10 tokens) got deprioritized on L4 after kernel swap. Scheduler prefers filling larger batches to keep GPU utilization high. Increasing fairshare decay from 0.6 -> 0.8 reduced starvation.

leah: Can we run a targeted sweep: batch_window_ms in [8,12,20,30] x max_batch_tokens in [2048,4096] x kernel in [basic,attn-tilt-v2] on APAC L4? I'll schedule it.

ops-bot: job submitted: sweep-195555-apac-l4 (ETA ~45m)

jia: Also enabling prefix cache for hot routes shaved ~18% off H100 p95 in a quick test.

sam: @leah please include per-tenant P99 and request-size buckets (1-20, 21-128, 129-512, >512). Need to validate fairness across cohorts.

leah: Ack — will add per-tenant buckets, kernel trace, and kv-cache hit rates to the sweep artifacts.

jia: Note: attn-tilt-v2's kernel path intentionally disables continuous coalescing for tiny requests (<=32 tokens) to avoid kernel overhead; that's why p99 for small requests spiked. We can try forcing coalesce_small=true to measure overhead vs tail benefit.

Tom: Next steps: run sweep, run eval quality pass, then decide whether to roll attn-tilt-v2 on H100-only first. If APAC L4 still degrades, use fallback to attn-basic via runtime policy.

jia: :thumbsup: I'll collect dashboards and perf traces and upload when ready: https://redwood.internal/dash/bench/195555

leah: putting sweep config in the run metadata now. Will post results in this thread.

infra-bot: artifact: s3://redwood-bench/sweep-195555-apac-l4/ (logs + traces)

sam: thanks — good baseline.
